fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. 2 passport size photos * 2. Copy of passport * 3. Certificate of no criminal record * 4. English Language proficiency certificate * 5. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 6. High school academic transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 7. Two letters of recommendation from experts * 8. Proof of Financial Guarantee * 9. Study plan(not less than 500 words) * 10. Physical examination record for foreigner * 11. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -All applicants for undergraduate programs are required to take the Mathematics test (with the option to choose the test language according to the instruction language). Applicants to Chinese-taught undergraduate programs must also take the Humanities Chinese test, but those applying for English-taught programs are exempt; applicants to the Chinese language undergraduate program may be exempt from the Humanities Chinese test if they provide a valid HSK Level 4 score. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1 Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, possess the required academic qualifications, and meet the language proficiency requirements. 2 CSCA subjects requirements: Mathematics. 3 Applicants must hold a high school diploma or equivalent to the Chinese high school level and be non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport. Language requirements: For English-taught programs, applicants musthave an IELTS score of 5.0, a TOEFL score of 60 or above, or pass an English interview conducted by telephone. Applicants who completed their previous education in English-speaking regions with English as the teaching language, are generally exempt from providing English language certificates.
